title: Bloomiro MCP: Connect Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT | Bloomiro
excerpt: Bloomiro MCP connects Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT to live Google Search Console, AI mentions, competitor gaps, scans, and Action Center. Agent-ready SEO on every plan.
content_html:
Model Context Protocol

Optimization and action in your AI workflow.

Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and VS Code to your live Bloomiro project. Your AI can use Google Search Console, AI mention checks, community citation sources, competitor gaps, page scans, and prioritized tasks from Bloomiro's proprietary Optimization and Action Layer, without leaving your workflow.

What teams do with Bloomiro MCP

Real workflows from teams connecting Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT to live Bloomiro data and Optimization and Action Layer findings.

Fix SEO while you ship

Pull live page scan issues, GSC queries, and prioritized tasks into Cursor or Claude Code. Act on Optimization and Action Layer findings in the same session where you read the data.

Research competitors in chat

Ask your assistant to compare your visibility vs competitors using real competitor scan data from your Bloomiro project, then decide what to improve next.

Track AI mentions on buyer prompts

Run AI presence checks from ChatGPT or Claude. See whether your brand shows up on the prompts your buyers actually ask.

Inspect community pages AI already cites

Ask which Wikipedia, Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, or review pages show up in answers, then open the exact URLs and prompt IDs from get_community_sources.

Turn gaps into actions

Create, update, and close SEO and GEO tasks from MCP. Bloomiro's Action Layer findings stay one list your team can work from in the dashboard or in your AI workflow.

MCP tool catalog

All 27 publicly available tools for SEO, GEO, GSC, GA4, Google and AI search, competitors, AI presence, community sources, CMS, and Action Center. Call get_mcp_guide only when a request or field is genuinely ambiguous.

  • get_page_insights

    List or read saved page analyses, with full content as a resource.

  • get_page_speed

    Live Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse scores, CWV, and diagnostics.

  • find_opportunities

    Highest-priority actions across search, crawls, AI, and competitors.

AI presence and competitorsMeasured AI answers, observed searches, Google fan-out, and competitor evidence.

  • get_ai_presence

    Overview, prompts, runs, status, or one model result through a view.

  • get_ai_answer

    Read one tracked model answer with mentions, citations, and search trace metadata.

  • get_ai_search_trace

    Observed underlying searches from tracked ChatGPT and other model results, when exposed.

    Google AI Overview and SERP fan-out from saved PAA, related searches, and citations.

  • get_community_sources

    Wikipedia, Reddit, Quora, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, and review pages cited in AI answers (overview, urls, lookup).

  • get_competitor_insights

    Competitor list, scan, visibility gap, or content coverage through a view.

  • manage_prompts

    Create, edit, archive, or restore prompt groups and buyer prompts.

  • manage_competitors

    Add, update, archive, or restore tracked competitors.

Action Center and external actionsRead tracked work separately from reversible writes and Google actions.

  • get_work_items

    Read Action Center checklist items, notes, and priorities (not a billing plan).

  • manage_work_items

    Add, update, complete, move, or remove Action Center checklist items without a full rewrite.

  • request_gsc_indexing

    Ask Google to crawl a URL on your property.

  • get_cms

    Read optional Bloomiro CMS status, documents, page content, and schema.

  • manage_cms

    Create, save, publish, unpublish, or delete Headless CMS pages when connected.

Supported MCP clients

OAuth connect for Claude, ChatGPT, and Perplexity. HTTP MCP for Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, and Codex.

Most clients take under two minutes. Sign in once, pick a site, and approve access.

    Sign up, add your site, and connect Google Search Console if you use it.

    Authorize MCP

    Open the connect flow, sign in, pick a project, and approve access for your MCP client.

  3. Start chatting

    Add a /compare page for AI visibility tools. That's your top competitor gap.

Frequently asked questions

What is Bloomiro MCP?

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard for connecting AI assistants to tools and data. Bloomiro MCP is a server at https://mcp.bloomiro.com/mcp that brings your live Bloomiro project into Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and VS Code. Your AI can read the same Google and AI visibility data, scans, competitor gaps, and prioritized tasks that power Bloomiro's proprietary Optimization and Action Layer in the dashboard.

How does MCP relate to Bloomiro's Optimization and Action Layer?

The Optimization and Action Layer is Bloomiro's proprietary system on top of visibility analytics. The Optimization Layer is where teams view what to optimize and change. The Action Layer turns recommendations into workflows, next steps, and create actions. MCP does not replace that layer. It connects your AI tools to the same project context so you can optimize and act inside Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT.

What data does Bloomiro MCP connect?

Google Search Console (queries, pages, clicks, impressions), Site Scan and Page Scan findings, competitor scans, AI presence results across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, community citation sources (Wikipedia, Reddit, Quora, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, reviews), prioritized SEO and GEO tasks, and sitemap search across your site or competitors.

Why use MCP instead of copying exports?

Spreadsheets and screenshots go stale the moment you paste them. MCP returns current project state: the task list after yesterday's deploy, GSC after the weekend sync, or a competitor scan from this morning. Your assistant cites real scores and URLs from your property instead of guessing.

Who is Bloomiro MCP for?

Founders shipping fixes in Cursor or Claude Code, SaaS marketers who research in ChatGPT but need live visibility data, agencies where each teammate connects their own MCP key to shared org projects, and teams doing GEO who want AI mention checks next to traditional SEO tasks.

How does MCP handle access and privacy?

MCP connects to your personal Bloomiro account via OAuth or your own API key. Organization projects, competitors, and scans follow your org settings. Private tasks and page scans stay private to you and the org owner. You choose which site to authorize during connect. Multi-site users call get_project_context to resolve a domain or site_id, then pass site_id explicitly to later calls.

Which tools support Bloomiro MCP?

Cursor, Claude (custom connector), ChatGPT (custom app with Developer mode), Claude Code, Codex, VS Code, and Perplexity connectors. OAuth is the default path. Some clients also support a local stdio server with a token from the connect page.

Does MCP use credits?

Most saved-data reads, including project context, tasks, GSC, crawler policy, and the compact MCP guide, are free. Fresh site, page, competitor, visibility, and AI presence analyses use credits under the same rules as the dashboard. run_analysis returns credits_used with the job result.

How do I connect Bloomiro MCP?

In your Bloomiro account, open your project's MCP tab in the dashboard. There is a setup guide for each supported client. Use https://mcp.bloomiro.com/mcp as the MCP server URL when your client asks for it.

Can I connect ChatGPT or Claude to a headless CMS with Bloomiro?

Yes. Bloomiro MCP can work with Bloomiro's Headless CMS so assistants in ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor can draft, revise, and publish site pages with your live visibility context. For the CMS-focused walkthrough, see the guide on connecting ChatGPT and Claude to Bloomiro CMS. MCP itself connects your SEO and AI visibility project; CMS publish is a separate capability when Headless is connected.

Is Bloomiro MCP included in pricing?

Yes. MCP access is included on Builder and Growth plans at no extra fee. You still need a Bloomiro subscription and project; MCP connects to your own account, not a shared demo workspace.

What can I ask after connecting?

Examples: "What are my open SEO tasks?", "How do we compare to competitors on AI visibility?", "Which Reddit or YouTube pages do AI answers cite for us?", "Scan this URL for GEO issues", "What queries drove impressions last month in GSC?", or "Run AI presence on our buyer prompts."

How do I read Community Sources from MCP?

Ask for a Community Sources overview first, then the page list for a platform when you need URLs. Prompt text is optional so responses stay small. It reads your latest completed AI presence run and does not start a new crawl by itself.

Connect Bloomiro MCP in your workflow

Bring live Google and AI visibility data, plus prioritized tasks from Bloomiro's proprietary Optimization and Action Layer, into Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and VS Code. Included on Builder and Growth plans.

模型上下文协议

Optimization and action in your AI workflow.

Model Context Protocol (MCP) connects Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and VS Code to your live Bloomiro project. Your AI can use Google Search Console, AI mention checks, community citation sources, competitor gaps, page scans, and prioritized tasks from Bloomiro's proprietary Optimization and Action Layer, without leaving your workflow.

What teams do with Bloomiro MCP

Real workflows from teams connecting Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT to live Bloomiro data and Optimization and Action Layer findings.

Fix SEO while you ship

Pull live page scan issues, GSC queries, and prioritized tasks into Cursor or Claude Code. Act on Optimization and Action Layer findings in the same session where you read the data.

Research competitors in chat

Ask your assistant to compare your visibility vs competitors using real competitor scan data from your Bloomiro project, then decide what to improve next.

Track AI mentions on buyer prompts

Run AI presence checks from ChatGPT or Claude. See whether your brand shows up on the prompts your buyers actually ask.

Inspect community pages AI already cites

Ask which Wikipedia, Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, or review pages show up in answers, then open the exact URLs and prompt IDs from get_community_sources.

Turn gaps into actions

Create, update, and close SEO and GEO tasks from MCP. Bloomiro's Action Layer findings stay one list your team can work from in the dashboard or in your AI workflow.

MCP tool catalog

All 27 publicly available tools for SEO, GEO, GSC, GA4, Google and AI search, competitors, AI presence, community sources, CMS, and Action Center. Call get_mcp_guide only when a request or field is genuinely ambiguous.

Context and guidanceResolve the site once and get compact help only when needed.
  • get_project_contextResolve site_id, domain, integrations, permissions, and data freshness.
  • get_mcp_guideCompact routing help for ambiguous requests and unfamiliar fields.
Search, SEO, and GEORead Google data, audit evidence, technical checks, or start one typed analysis.
  • get_search_performanceGSC queries, pages, clicks, impressions, CTR, position, and freshness.
  • get_business_profileGoogle Business Profile discovery, clicks, calls, directions, and keywords (beta).
  • get_web_analyticsConnected GA4 traffic, acquisition, pages, events, conversions, and setup.
  • get_site_insightsSaved site crawl or combined SEO, GEO, GSC, profile, and AI summary.
  • get_page_insightsList or read saved page analyses, with full content as a resource.
  • manage_page_scansDelete one or many saved page scans by analysis ID.
  • search_sitemapSearch your site or a competitor sitemap by topic.
  • get_robots_txtCompact crawler rules for search and AI user agents.
  • get_domain_ratingCurrent Ahrefs Domain Rating with required attribution and license link.
  • get_page_speedLive Google PageSpeed Insights and Lighthouse scores, CWV, and diagnostics.
  • find_opportunitiesHighest-priority actions across search, crawls, AI, and competitors.
  • run_analysisStart a site, page, visibility, AI presence, or competitor analysis.

常见问题

What is Bloomiro MCP?

Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard for connecting AI assistants to tools and data. Bloomiro MCP is a server at https://mcp.bloomiro.com/mcp that brings your live Bloomiro project into Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and VS Code. Your AI can read the same Google and AI visibility data, scans, competitor gaps, and prioritized tasks that power Bloomiro's proprietary Optimization and Action Layer in the dashboard.

How does MCP relate to Bloomiro's Optimization and Action Layer?

The Optimization and Action Layer is Bloomiro's proprietary system on top of visibility analytics. The Optimization Layer is where teams view what to optimize and change. The Action Layer turns recommendations into workflows, next steps, and create actions. MCP does not replace that layer. It connects your AI tools to the same project context so you can optimize and act inside Cursor, Claude, or ChatGPT.

What data does Bloomiro MCP connect?

Google Search Console (queries, pages, clicks, impressions), Site Scan and Page Scan findings, competitor scans, AI presence results across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, community citation sources (Wikipedia, Reddit, Quora, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, reviews), prioritized SEO and GEO tasks, and sitemap search across your site or competitors.

Why use MCP instead of copying exports?

Spreadsheets and screenshots go stale the moment you paste them. MCP returns current project state: the task list after yesterday's deploy, GSC after the weekend sync, or a competitor scan from this morning. Your assistant cites real scores and URLs from your property instead of guessing.

Who is Bloomiro MCP for?

Founders shipping fixes in Cursor or Claude Code, SaaS marketers who research in ChatGPT but need live visibility data, agencies where each teammate connects their own MCP key to shared org projects, and teams doing GEO who want AI mention checks next to traditional SEO tasks.

How does MCP handle access and privacy?

MCP connects to your personal Bloomiro account via OAuth or your own API key. Organization projects, competitors, and scans follow your org settings. Private tasks and page scans stay private to you and the org owner. You choose which site to authorize during connect. Multi-site users call get_project_context to resolve a domain or site_id, then pass site_id explicitly to later calls.

Which tools support Bloomiro MCP?

Cursor, Claude (custom connector), ChatGPT (custom app with Developer mode), Claude Code, Codex, VS Code, and Perplexity connectors. OAuth is the default path. Some clients also support a local stdio server with a token from the connect page.

Does MCP use credits?

Most saved-data reads, including project context, tasks, GSC, crawler policy, and the compact MCP guide, are free. Fresh site, page, competitor, visibility, and AI presence analyses use credits under the same rules as the dashboard. run_analysis returns credits_used with the job result.

How do I connect Bloomiro MCP?

In your Bloomiro account, open your project's MCP tab in the dashboard. There is a setup guide for each supported client. Use https://mcp.bloomiro.com/mcp as the MCP server URL when your client asks for it.

Can I connect ChatGPT or Claude to a headless CMS with Bloomiro?

是的。 Bloomiro MCP can work with Bloomiro's Headless CMS so assistants in ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor can draft, revise, and publish site pages with your live visibility context. For the CMS-focused walkthrough, see the guide on connecting ChatGPT and Claude to Bloomiro CMS. MCP itself connects your SEO and AI visibility project; CMS publish is a separate capability when Headless is connected.

Is Bloomiro MCP included in pricing?

是的。 MCP access is included on Builder and Growth plans at no extra fee. You still need a Bloomiro subscription and project; MCP connects to your own account, not a shared demo workspace.

What can I ask after connecting?

Examples: "What are my open SEO tasks?", "How do we compare to competitors on AI visibility?", "Which Reddit or YouTube pages do AI answers cite for us?", "Scan this URL for GEO issues", "What queries drove impressions last month in GSC?", or "Run AI presence on our buyer prompts."

How do I read Community Sources from MCP?

Ask for a Community Sources overview first, then the page list for a platform when you need URLs. Prompt text is optional so responses stay small. It reads your latest completed AI presence run and does not start a new crawl by itself.

Connect Bloomiro MCP in your workflow

Bring live Google and AI visibility data, plus prioritized tasks from Bloomiro's proprietary Optimization and Action Layer, into Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and VS Code. Included on Builder and Growth plans.
